ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
People sometimes use the method of "ramming" to compact loose ground. Suppose a certain instance of ramming follows the following model: four people simultaneously apply an external force to a heavy object through bamboo poles (the resultant force of the two bamboo poles), with each external force having a magnitude of $F = 450\mathrm{N}$ and directed vertically upward. The heavy object leaves the ground at a height of $h_1 = 20\mathrm{cm}$ before the people stop applying the force, and finally, the heavy object falls freely and impacts the ground to a depth of $h_2 = 3\mathrm{cm}$. Air resistance can be neglected, and the mass of the heavy object is known to be $m = 80\mathrm{kg}$.

1. The speed of the heavy object just as it hits the ground.
2. The average impact force exerted by a heavy object on the ground.

从初始在地面静止到重物再次回到地面、即将撞击地面前，重力是保守力，起点和撞击前都在地面高度，重力势能变化为 0。因此撞击前的动能等于四个外力做的功：

所以 N_avg h2 = (1/2)mv^2 + mgh2。
代入：N_avg × 0.03 = 360 + 80 × 10 × 0.03 = 360 + 24 = 384，
N_avg = 384 / 0.03 = 12800 N。
地面对重物的平均力与重物对地面的平均冲击力大小相等，因此平均冲击力为 12800 N。

People sometimes use the method of "ramming" to compact loose ground. Suppose a certain instance of ramming follows the following model: four people simultaneously apply an external force to a heavy object through bamboo poles, with each external force having a magnitude of $F = 450\mathrm{N}$ and directed vertically upward. The heavy object leaves the ground at a height of $h_1 = 20\mathrm{cm}$ before the people stop applying the force, and finally, the heavy object falls freely and impacts the ground to a depth of $h_2 = 3\mathrm{cm}$. Air resistance can be neglected, and the mass of the heavy object is known to be $m = 80\mathrm{kg}$.

1. The speed of the heavy object just as it hits the ground.
2. The average impact force exerted by the heavy object on the ground.
